name: ginem
description: Monorepo with Express API (packages/api) and React Dashboard (packages/dashboard)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,DASHBOARD -c blue,green "npm run dev -w packages/api" "npm run dev -w packages/dashboard"
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -n API,DASHBOARD -c blue,green "npm run start -w packages/api" "npm run start -w packages/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/api && npm run build -w packages/dashboard
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/api/node_modules packages/dashboard/node_modules && npm install
